svg.aria-label: The half box drawn as a Cantor set and its square
svg.title: The half box drawn as a Cantor set and its square

g.text: The half box as a fractal: keep the two outer quarters, again and again
Each level: twice the pieces, a quarter the size.
Double the size → √2 times as much: dimension ½.
like a stick, yet it is dust: no two touch,
and its shadow on the side shrinks to nothing.
